segments.text: Hello friends, welcome to your channel HSC Study Guide.
segments.zh: 朋友们好，欢迎来到你们的频道 HSE Study Guide。

segments.text: In today's video, we will talk about how to get a safe working distance from the O-RAID electrical transmission line.
segments.zh: 今天这期视频我们要讲，与架空输电线路之间应该保持怎样的安全作业距离。

segments.text: So let's start the video.
segments.zh: 那我们开始吧。

segments.text: First of all, you should know what is the high voltage transmission line.
segments.zh: 首先你要知道什么是高压输电线路。

segments.text: First of all, there are HV, i.e. High Voltage Lines.
segments.zh: 首先是 HV，也就是高压线路。

segments.text: So in this high voltage transmission line, the voltage level is up to 230 KV per 100 KV.
segments.zh: 在这种高压输电线路中，电压等级是 100 KV 到 230 KV，

segments.text: So this voltage comes under HV, i.e. comes under High Voltage.
segments.zh: 所以这个电压属于 HV，也就是属于高压。

segments.text: Then there is EHV, i.e. Extra High Voltage Line.
segments.zh: 然后是 EHV，也就是超高压线路，

segments.text: So the voltage level in this is up to 230 KV per 1000 KV.
segments.zh: 它的电压等级是 230 KV 到 1000 KV。

segments.text: Third is UHV, i.e. Ultra High Voltage Line.
segments.zh: 第三是 UHV，也就是特高压线路，

segments.text: So the level of voltage in this is above 1000 KV.
segments.zh: 它的电压等级在 1000 KV 以上，

segments.text: So it is called UHV, i.e. Ultra High Voltage Line.
segments.zh: 所以它叫做 UHV，也就是特高压线路。

segments.text: So in this way, there is a high voltage transmission line, which is quite important for you to know.
segments.zh: 所以高压输电线路就是这样分的，了解这些对你来说相当重要。

segments.text: So let's know how safe working distance should be from the O-RAID power line.
segments.zh: 那我们来了解一下，与架空电力线之间应该保持多大的安全作业距离。

segments.text: So if the voltage is up to 11 KV, then we have to keep a safe working distance of 1.40 m.
segments.zh: 如果电压在 11 KV 以下，我们就要保持 1.40 m 的安全作业距离。

segments.text: Second is that if the voltage is up to 33 KV with 11 KV, then we have to keep a safe working distance of 3.60 m.
segments.zh: 第二，如果电压在 11 KV 到 33 KV 之间，我们就要保持 3.60 m 的安全作业距离。

segments.text: Third is that if the voltage is up to 132 KV with 33 KV, then we have to keep a safe working distance of 4.70 m.
segments.zh: 第三，如果电压在 33 KV 到 132 KV 之间，我们就要保持 4.70 m 的安全作业距离。

segments.text: After that, if the voltage is up to 232 KV with 233 KV, then we have to keep a safe working distance of 5.70 m.
segments.zh: 之后，如果电压在 233 KV 到 232 KV 之间，我们就要保持 5.70 m 的安全作业距离。

segments.text: And after that, if the voltage is up to 473 KV with 473 KV, then we have to maintain a safe working distance of 6.50 m.
segments.zh: 然后在那之后，如果电压在 473 KV 到 473 KV 之间，我们就要保持 6.50 m 的安全作业距离。

segments.text: So in this way, we have to maintain a safe working distance of O-RAID power line.
segments.zh: 所以这样，我们就要与架空电力线保持安全作业距离。

segments.text: So friends, I hope that through this video, you got to know how safe working distance of O-RAID power line should be from the O-RAID power line.
segments.zh: 朋友们，希望通过这期视频，你们了解到了与架空电力线之间的安全作业距离应该是多少。

segments.text: So that's all for today, see you with another topic, till then take care, bye bye.
segments.zh: 今天就到这里，下期带着另一个主题再见，在那之前请多保重，拜拜。
